retirement:earlyend: Own-terms end on the stated 'until' date. Under the owner's 2026-10-21 ruling the end is recorded as that date, inclusive (the exemption runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading, under which the exemption stops when that day begins, is the stated alternative. The date is a fixed term of the grant, not a deadline on some other act. No held record shows the employee's death or separation before that date; if such a record is found, the claim must be reopened to decide whether the exemption lapsed earlier. No held order amends, revokes or shortens this order.
retirement:indep: The order contains one operative command, the time-limited exemption of one named employee. The recital of section 204 and the identification of the employee are not independent commands.
retirement:savings: Service performed and pay earned while the exemption ran are accrued effects. Any annuity or retirement-credit consequence flows from the retirement statutes, not from the order, and does not keep the order operative: the order commands nothing after its stated date. The census register titles, the WPA 1944 numbered list and a full-text search of the held order texts show no later order naming this employee.
closing:indep: The closing of the offices and the excusal of employees from duty are one command limited to the stated day or days. No part of the order operates after the last stated day.
